```{r}

library(gapminder)
head(gapminder)
data("gapminder")
gapminder |> 
  filter(lifeExp < 29) |> 
  head(6)

```

```{r}
gapminder |> filter(country == "Rwanda", year > 1979) |> head(6)
```

```{r} 
new <- gapminder |> select(-gdpPercap) |> head(6)
```

```{r}
gapminder |> 
  arrange(lifeExp) |> head(6)
```
```{r}
gapminder |>
  arrange(desc(lifeExp))
```

```{r}
library(ggplot2)
data("trees")
head("trees")

ggplot(trees, aes(x= Girth)) + geom_histogram(fill = "black", color= "blue", binwidth = 2) + labs(title = "Distribution of girth")

```

```{r}
library(ggplot2)
ggplot(trees, aes(x= Volume)) + geom_histogram(fill = "pink", color= "yellow", bindwidth = 2) + labs(title = "Distribution of Volume")
```


```{r}
library(ggplot2)
ggplot(trees, aes(x= Volume, y=Girth)) + geom_point(fill = "blue", color="red", bindwidth = 4) + labs(title= "Volume vs Girth")

```

```{r}
library(ggplot2)
shapiro.test(trees$Volume)

# not normal distribution

```
```{r}
library(ggplot2)
shapiro.test(trees$Girth)

# Normal
```
